subtasks.title: Fix Scout onboarding salutation to a markdown hard break + regression test
subtasks.approach:
In ScoutOnboardingNotification::toMail(), replace ->salutation('Thanks,
Insight LPR Team') with ->salutation("Thanks, \nInsight LPR Team") (two trailing spaces + newline = CommonMark hard break, which survives EncodedHtmlString escaping and renders a real line break in both HTML and plain-text parts). Add a feature test that renders the notification's MailMessage and pins: no literal/escaped
text, a real line break in HTML, and subject/action/expiry unchanged.
subtasks.intended_diffs: ScoutOnboardingNotification.php:39 — swap the salutation string. New test file mirrors tests/Feature/Mail/Scout/OneTimePasswordNotificationTest.php convention.

excluded_sites:
All static-blade markdown
